description.text: Duration: Two years Time for Admission Application: Before June 30th Courses Introduction to China, Advanced Chinese, Chinese Literature, Teaching Chinese as a Second Language, Multicultural Communication, Comparative on China Culture and Abroad, Classic of China Culture, Chinese Curriculum and Teaching Method, Teaching Test and Evaluation, Language, Culture, Education, Chinese Culture and Communication, China Culture Experience, Teaching and Intern, Theses, etc.

duration.text: The Master of Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages at Xiamen University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. 1-2 academic theses

requirements.text: 1.All kinds of overseas people, including foreigners and overseas Chinese in Hongkong, Macao, Taiwan and foreign countries. 2.People with undergraduate diplomas or those graduating from a junior college more than 2 years ago Notes: Overseas Chinese should take the National Entrance Examination of every April; Foreigners can enroll without taking exams and should learn Chinese for one year in case of their poor Chinese language skills.
